summary: Iteration 5 — validated all four issues fixed by main agent: (1) admin & super_admin can CLOSE (PATCH status='resolved') and REOPEN complaints; subscriber PATCH → 403. (2) Overview renders 4 metric cards; taps navigate to correct tabs (metric-tickets→complaints, metric-subscribers→subscribers). (3) Subscribers CRUD by super_admin: create with router_model/router_mac/security_deposit/installation_date/notes/plan+cash → response has activated.invoice + activated.subscription; PATCH updates fields; POST /assign-plan {payment_mode:'free'} → invoice.amount=0.0 + active subscription; invalid plan_id → 404; admin (non-super) POST/PATCH/DELETE → 403 as expected, and admin UI hides add-subscriber-fab / assign-plan-btn / edit-subscriber-btn / delete-subscriber-btn while still allowing search + read-only detail sheet. (4) Timing: GET /api/complaints and /api/invoices created_at now contain a '+00:00' offset (tz-aware) — regex TZ_RE checks passed on all sampled records. Recharge (POST /api/recharge, payment_mode='upi') still works and returns tz-aware created_at. Backend pytest: 17/17 PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_admin_close_and_subscribers.py. Frontend UI smoke (390x844, Expo web preview): super_admin overview→tickets nav OK, super_admin add-subscriber via FAB creates+deletes subscriber via web confirm-delete-btn modal OK, admin-close-ticket button closes ticket via UI, admin (non-super) sees no FAB and no assign/edit/delete on detail sheet. All previously-verified flows from iter1-4 (auth, recharge, chat, helpline, OTP resend, auto-assign, team accept) remain intact. RN Web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*→boxShadow, props.pointerEvents→style.pointerEvents) — non-blocking, carried over from iter4.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:22 AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url, tz_aware=True) — the fix that made created_at/updated_at tz-aware on read. Combined with Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc)) on Complaint/Invoice/User/ChatMessage models the ISO output is now correctly suffixed with '+00:00'. Verified via TZ_RE against /api/complaints and /api/invoices.

server.py:590 create_subscriber — plan_id lookup happens BEFORE user insert; invalid plan → 404 returned without partial writes. Body fields (router_model, router_mac, security_deposit, installation_date, notes) are correctly spread into User via body.model_dump(exclude={phone,name,plan_id,payment_mode}).

server.py:380 activate_plan — payment_mode='free' correctly sets invoice.amount=0.0; previous subscriptions marked expired via update_many before inserting the new active one. Verified.

frontend/app/(admin)/overview.tsx:72-75 — all 4 MetricCard pressables render as web <button> and are tappable; router.push routes to the right (admin) tab. Fixes the reported 'dashboard touch not working'.

rca_of_issue: Original bugs & main-agent fixes (all validated): (a) admin close-ticket — was ONLY exposed for role='team'; main agent added the admin/super_admin branch in the sheet (complaints.tsx:151-161) which calls api.updateComplaint(id, {status:'resolved', resolution_note}); backend server.py:511 already allowed admin/super_admin to PATCH status, no backend change needed. (b) dashboard touch not working — root cause: metric cards previously had onPress but were wrapped in a way that swallowed touch (or missing testID); fix uses Pressable with explicit onPress={() => router.push(...)} + testID (overview.tsx:72-75). Verified all four cards tappable and navigate. (c) subscriber details fields — new Pydantic fields on User model (router_model, router_mac, security_deposit, installation_date, notes) + CreateSubscriberBody / UpdateSubscriberBody + a full modal form in subscribers.tsx (lines 258-328) with plan+payment chips; assign-plan endpoint reused activate_plan helper. (d) timing not proper — root cause: motor was reading created_at as naive datetimes because the collection stored them without tz info OR the client was not tz-aware. Fix: AsyncIOMotorClient(..., tz_aware=True) (server.py:22) combined with Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc)) on every timestamped model means ISO serialization now emits '+00:00'. Regression coverage added in TestTimezoneAwareTimestamps.
